descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S25 Side by side with prototype p72, and the UAT screenshot of the summary-failed state

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U1 The Pre-Round tab has two boxes: the dictation (most of the screen) and Important Points (TC-12). (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 How it works 1; TFA-92590 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress
  • T6 A screenshot of the summary-failed state, as built, is attached to the UAT so testers know what correct looks like. (TFA-94745 AC 8)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html and the S01/S02 results

When Compare the summary shape and order (Background one-liner + active-issue bullets, then vitals, labs, imaging/diagnostic tests, medications, tasks), the editor layout and the failed-state screen; check the UAT has the state-3 screenshot

Then Matches the prototype (or the differences are listed for Q4); the screenshot is attached

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review; the AC 8 screenshot is present or absent

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
